summary: Tested recruiter portal end-to-end: backend recruiter auth (signup/login/me), public feeds (industries/sub-industries/states/cities), and full frontend flows on /recruiter and /recruiter/signup. All 13 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend landing renders, plans/FAQ visible, login (wrong+correct), logout, header signup nav, required-field toast, dropdown state->city population, and e2e signup->logged-in card with 'pending' status all pass. Admin regression (/admin/login with admin@hireme.in) loads dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup: backend does not validate mobile/designation/addressLine1/zipCode formats or emptiness — front-end enforces some of these, but API accepts empty strings. Consider Pydantic validators.
Password strength not enforced on signup (any length accepted).
recruiter_login accepts case-insensitive email but no rate limiting on login attempts.
seed_data_creation: Test companies created via /recruiter/signup with TEST_ / test_ui_ prefixed emails; not cleaned up (companies collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recruiter auth uses Bearer token in localStorage key 'hireme_recruiter_token'. Admin JWT is rejected by /api/recruiter/me due to type claim. Public feeds: states master has data; cities?state=Gujarat returns 236 rows in tests. All data-testids used match spec.
